content.short: Crypto Heroez is a Cardano NFT and education project profiling influential people in crypto history.
content.description: Crypto Heroez is a Cardano NFT and educational project built around the people who shaped cryptocurrency history. The project presents notable crypto figures as collectible hero-style cards while also giving users context about their influence, milestones, and place in the wider timeline of blockchain development. Its goal is not only to sell collectibles, but to make crypto history easier to explore through visual assets and short educational material. Crypto Heroez connects NFT collecting with learning about the broader ecosystem.
content.meta: Crypto Heroez turns influential crypto figures into Cardano NFT collectibles and learning material. Explore Crypto Heroez on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
